LCR SERIES CIRCUITS
The purpose of this experiment is to demonstrate the normal operation of an LCR series circuit.
EXPERIMENT
Pick up the PC130-17 card. This card is used to demonstrate the operation of LCR series circuits.
Compare the card with the schematic shown.
Notice that there are three LCR series circuits. S1, S2, S3 are used to select the circuit.
Also notice that the values of resistance, capacitance, and inductance are the same in all three circuits.
Since all L, C, and R components are identical, the voltages and waveforms across them are the same no matter where they are placed in the circuit.
This allows measuring all three circuit components using an oscilloscope reference to ground.
ER is measured across R1. EC is measured across C2, and EL is measured across L3.
